_comment: Regression baseline set 'busy-agx-lut-effects': AgX tone mapper, a 3D LUT, colour calibration, centre/glow/halation, chromatic aberration, grain and a small rotation. lutPath is relative to this file; baseline.py rewrites it to an absolute path before rendering. Keys from RapidRAW src-tauri/src/image_processing.rs and adjustment_utils.rs. Changing any value invalidates the reference renders.
